name: Wall dink, step back, then volley
summary: Alone at a wall, play a bounced ball from inside a taped non-volley-zone line, step back behind the line with both feet, then volley; a volley with a foot on or over the line counts as an own fault.
setup: Tape a line on the floor about 2.5 m from a flat wall (the non-volley-zone line) and a line on the wall about 1 m high (the net)
Drop-feed a soft ball short so it bounces inside the floor line; step in, let it bounce and dink it softly against the wall above the wall line
Before the rebound arrives, step back so both feet are behind the floor line, then volley the rebound softly above the wall line; catch the next rebound and repeat
Count an own fault for a volley with a foot on or over the floor line, and for a ball below the wall line. Sets of 10 patterns; rest 30 s between sets
success_criterion: In each of 3 sets of 10 dink-step-back-volley patterns, at most 1 own fault
safety_notes: Soft pace only and the ball below head height. Step back with short steps while facing the wall; do not hop or lunge. Clear the floor of loose balls between sets. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) A common own fault (AN-07 fault share) is volleying right after playing a bounced ball inside the non-volley zone, before both feet are back out. Pairing the bounced shot with a forced step back before every volley builds the habit, with no partner or court. The fault rule this drill counts is UNVERIFIED (docs/domain/rules-verified.md).
